text:
sofia: Follow-up: distilled action items from the KV shard OOM postmortem. We want owners, small measurable experiments, and rollforward/rollback criteria.

raj: Taking profiling + repro harness. I'll enable 30s heap snapshots on canaries and collect jemalloc stats + pprof traces. Ticket INF-4950. ETA 2026-03-26.

tara: I'll own eviction policy experiments and the alert threshold PR. Matrix: LRU, size-weighted, TTL-priority. Will create a harness to inject long-lived keys. INF-4954. ETA 2026-03-29.

mike: I'll test allocator/GC knobs: smaller slab pages, more frequent incremental GC, and limiting inflight keys. Sharing config diff + microbench. INF-4957. ETA 2026-03-29.

ops-bot: Reminder: KV-oom sync 2026-03-24 17:00 UTC.

jen: I can provision temporary Dedicated canaries in dedicated-east-2. Raj, tell me when.

raj: Also adding a CI regression that replays sticky-residency workload to catch growth regressions. Prototype PR by 2026-03-26.

sofia: Quick mitigator if experiments fail: enable eviction-probation and lower TTLs for non-critical keys as a canary rollout.

mike: Core capture for triage: `sudo gcore -o /tmp/core.$(date +%s) $PID` then `pprof --text /path/to/binary /tmp/core.<ts>`; I'll paste examples in INF-4957.

sofia: Alerts: propose soft at 85%, hard at 95%. @tara please PR to monitoring and attach dashboard with heap correlation.

raj: I'll add a small sampler to emit residency histograms and key-age percentiles every 60s.

sofia: Action summary in postmortem will be updated: INF-4950 (raj) due 2026-03-26, INF-4954 (tara) due 2026-03-29, INF-4957 (mike) due 2026-03-29, CI regression (raj) due 2026-03-26, canary capacity (jen) on-demand. Ping me if blocked.
